examples.label: Inflation
examples.title: Inflation slows but prices remain elevated as Iran war and spending on AI push up prices
examples.relationship_note: The story directly concerns the forecast quantity.
examples.selected_question: What are the chances US headline inflation rises above 4% at any point from September through December 2026?
examples.x_draft:
Inflation has eased, but price pressures haven't disappeared.

Did America declare victory over inflation too soon?

PolyBridge puts the chance of US headline inflation rising above 4% at any point from September through December at 18.4%.

examples.label: Jobs
examples.title: U.S. economy surprisingly lost 23,000 jobs in July
examples.relationship_note: The story directly concerns the forecast quantity.
examples.selected_question: How high does PolyBridge expect the US unemployment rate to get between September 2026 and March 2027?
examples.x_draft:
The US unexpectedly lost 23,000 jobs in July.

Does the wider jobs market weaken too?

PolyBridge expects unemployment to peak around 4.93% by the end of March '27.

https://www.axios.com/2026/08/07/july-jobs-report-employment-losses

examples.label: Treasury markets
examples.title: US treasury doubles debt buyback to steady bond market amid inflation fears
examples.relationship_note: The story helped choose the question. It did not update the model.
examples.selected_question: How strong does PolyBridge expect US economic growth to be in the fourth quarter of 2026?
examples.unit: Annualized percentage change in real GDP during Q4 2026
examples.x_draft:
Treasury is doubling long-end buybacks as pressure remains in bond markets.

How much does the economy slow?

PolyBridge's baseline for Q4 US real GDP growth is 2.37%.

https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/aug/19/us-treasury-doubles-debt-buyback-bond-market
